narrative: 当布景本身就是主体时，人类的剧情就成了访客。混凝土、玻璃、地毯和条状窗户才是真正在“说话”的元素。
一个人物提供尺度感，随后消失在图案之中。如果这场戏是一次谎言的特写，这就不是对的工具。
建筑无法呈现一次眼皮的抽动。如果你把一段对话淹没在立面之中，你拍到的只会是一栋建筑，而不是一场对话。
这并不天然等同于单点透视式的仪式感。一面平坦的立面、一处粗野主义的天花板、一片重复的办公室吊顶，都可以是建筑纹理，而不需要一条消失点隧道。
how: 根据材质来曝光：用侧光表现浮雕质感，或用平光表现图形化的网格。用长焦镜头把楼层压缩成纹理，或用广角镜头贴近一面墙，让人物在单一平面前显得渺小。
如果纹理是重点，就缩小光圈让砖石和接缝保持锐利。提示词：Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building.
when: 当地点的分量超过人物时使用它：初次抵达一座城市、一个身处机器中的工人、对一座纪念碑的批判。不要把它当作一场亲密戏份的唯一覆盖镜头。
vs: 单点透视（One-Point Perspective）把空间瞄准成一条隧道。建筑纹理则可能只是一面平坦、有触感的墙。
重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）计的是单元的数量。建筑纹理可以是不规则的、被浇筑和染色的材质。
极远景（Extreme Long Shot）把人物缩小在天地之间。这项技术则把人物缩小在建成的材质之中。
窗景构图（Windows）把开口本身当作主体。建筑纹理中的这些开口里则可能几乎没有人。
examples_film: 《游戏时间》（Playtime，即PlayTime）让现代巴黎“吞噬”它的访客：玻璃、网格和候客厅成为一种关于质感的喜剧；粗野主义的语言把浇筑的体量和材质置于舒适感之上。
人物依然存在，作为尺度感而存在。这是关于建筑的语法，而不是一张旅游明信片。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是一张背后有著名建筑的人物肖像。破绽是一张巨大的脸，配上一小条明信片般的立面。
修正方法：后退或换用长焦，直到身体成为诸多模块中的一个模块；或者干脆承认你想要的其实是一张肖像，放弃这个说法。

faq.q: 电影中的建筑纹理（Architexture）是什么？
faq.a: 它是一种把建筑当作主体的构图方式：立面、网格和材质充满画面。人物作为一个细节或尺度参照物存在。布景主导着空间。

faq.q: 建筑纹理（Architexture）与单点透视（One-Point Perspective）有何区别？
faq.a: 单点透视是一条由平行线汇聚而成的隧道，常带有仪式感。建筑纹理关乎材质和模块，可能是一面平坦的墙、一片吊顶网格，或一块没有消失点噱头的浇筑体量。它们可以在一个经过设计的大厅中结合，但也不必如此。

faq.q: 什么时候该用建筑纹理（Architexture）？
faq.a: 当建筑本身就是故事时使用它：抵达、劳作、纪念碑，或一套房间系统。不要把它用作一张必须被读出表情的脸的唯一镜头。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写建筑纹理（Architexture）的提示词？
faq.a: 让人物在材质中显得渺小。示例：Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building。指明混凝土、玻璃或网格。禁止肖像式的取景。

narrative: When the set is the subject, human plot becomes a visitor. Concrete, glass, carpet, and window bands do the talking.
A figure gives scale, then disappears into the pattern. It is the wrong tool when a close-up of a lie is the scene.
Architecture cannot deliver an eye twitch. If you drown a dialogue in facade, you will photograph a building and call it a conversation.
This is not automatically one-point ceremony. A flat elevation, a brutalist soffit, a repeating office ceiling can be architexture without a vanishing tunnel.
how: Expose for the material: raking light for relief, or flat light for graphic grids. Use a longer lens to compress floors into texture, or a wide lens close to a wall so the body is tiny against a single plane.

Stop down so brick and joint stay sharp if texture is the point. Prompt: Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building.
when: Use it when place outweighs person: first arrival in a city, a worker in a machine, a critic of a monument. Do not use it as the only coverage of an intimate scene.
vs: One-Point Perspective aims space as a tunnel. Architexture may be a flat, tactile wall.
Repetition and Pattern counts units. Architexture can be irregular material, poured and stained.
Extreme Long Shot shrinks a person in land. This shrinks them in built matter.
Windows makes apertures the subject. Architexture may have almost no people in those apertures.
examples_film: Playtime (PlayTime) lets modern Paris eat its visitors: glass, grid, and waiting room as comedy of texture. The Brutalist language puts poured mass and material ahead of comfort.
The person remains, as scale. Grammar of buildings, not a tourist postcard.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a human portrait with a famous building behind. The tell is a large face and a postcard sliver of facade.
The fix is to step back or go longer until the body is a module among modules, or to admit you wanted a portrait and drop the claim.

faq.a: It is composition that treats architecture as the subject: facades, grids, and materials filling the frame. A person remains as a detail or a scale figure. The set owns space.

One-point perspective is a tunnel of receding parallels, often ceremonial. Architexture is material and module, which might be a flat wall, a ceiling grid, or a poured mass with no vanishing showpiece. They can combine in a designed hall. They need not.
Use it when the building is the story: arrival, labor, monument, a system of rooms. Do not use it as the only shot of a face that must be read.

faq.q: How do I prompt architexture for AI image or video?
faq.a: Make the person small in material. Example: Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building. Name concrete, glass, or grid. Forbid portrait crop.
